Aries.Sun: The Sun, which is renowned for its brilliance, if it is in a dvadasamsa of Aries, produces the power of the (native's) father.
Aries.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Aries establishes a disease of his mother by means of changes caused by blood and bile.
Aries.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Aries makes a man having a treasure of gold and goats whose wealth is destroyed by thieves, fire, and foes.
Aries.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Aries produces one whose wife is polluted, hostile, or dead.
Aries.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Aries makes a clever man with famous wealth.
Aries.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Aries produces one who speaks much, but in a stumbling way, a fickle person whose friends are ill-behaved and terrible.
Aries.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Aries makes a vile man whose treasure is gained by the acquisitions of his servants, but a strong and handsome man.

Taurus.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Taurus destroys the beauty of his father.
Taurus.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Taurus gives prosperity, happiness, and food of his mother.
Taurus.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Taurus bestows firm and extensive wealth.
Taurus.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Taurus produces a man who has intercourse with lovely women and wives.
Taurus.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Taurus makes a pauper.
Taurus.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Taurus produces one who is friendly with women and has a firm, loud voice.
Taurus.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Taurus makes a man who is doorkeeper in a harem and whose body is slowly overcome by old age.

Gemini.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Gemini makes his father one who practices such things as sacrifices and is wealthy in family.
Gemini.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Gemini, which creates beauty, the respect of good men, and power, causes the happiness of his mother.
Gemini.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Gemini makes one whose money is gathered from the fine arts, oratory, and the sacred traditions (sruti).
Gemini.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Gemini makes a person who is the same to men and women and who has ignoble sons.
Gemini.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Gemini produces a man with handsome form who is learned in the fine arts, a clever person who takes pleasure in women.
Gemini.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Gemini makes one who is learned in oratory, sacred traditions (sruti), and crafts, whose friends are famous, and who speaks sweetly.
Gemini.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Gemini makes a fickle person who practices mischief and bad craftsmanship, and whose old age is attained with the strength of youth.

Cancer.Sun: If the Sun is in a dvadasamsa of Cancer, then (the native) obtains (a father) who is afflicted by disease, sickness, and troubles.
Cancer.Moon: If the Moon is in a dvadasamsa of Cancer, he obtains pleasures of his mother caused by health, beauty, and good appearance.
Cancer.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Cancer produces the highest, exalted wealth.
Cancer.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Cancer makes one whose sons are lowly.
Cancer.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Cancer produces a man abounding in treasures and titles who has a good wife and possesses a family and beauty.
Cancer.Mercury: Because of Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Cancer (the native) obtains powerful friends and the highest joy.
Cancer.Saturn: Because of Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Cancer he will grow old quickly, and is carried off by his servants, his bad wives, and so on.

Leo.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Leo causes victory and nobility of his father.
Leo.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Leo causes fear and disease of his mother.
Leo.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Leo causes the acquisition of wealth consisting mainly of cows which are obtained by labor and by serving his friends and the king.
Leo.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Leo makes one whose sons are not born or, if born, die.
Leo.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Leo makes a man who does not obtain a wife.
Leo.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Leo makes a man whose voice is broken and who has bad friends.
Leo.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Leo makes one overcome by old age who is not submissive to his lord.

Virgo.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Virgo gives poverty of his father.
Virgo.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Virgo gives poverty of his mother and makes him gentle and timid.
Virgo.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Virgo gives wealth pertaining to maidens.
Virgo.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Virgo causes the birth of eunuchs.
Virgo.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Virgo produces one whose wife has a soft and oppressed body.
Virgo.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Virgo makes a man prominent for his oratory and having good friends.
Virgo.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Virgo makes a man who grows old slowly, obeying others and serving women and evil people.

Libra.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Libra produces a father whose wealth is excessive, but who is deprived of health.
Libra.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Libra destroys the beauty and strength of his mother.
Libra.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Libra gives wealth from travels, merchandise, and trade.
Libra.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Libra produces a rogue with many sons.
Libra.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Libra produces a man with a noble (Arya) wife who knows business, sexual intercourse, and science.
Libra.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Libra produces a teacher who gives many speeches.
Libra.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Libra produces a youthful person with many servants.

Scorpio.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Scorpio causes the death of his father.
Scorpio.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Scorpio causes the death of his mother.
Scorpio.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Scorpio destroys his wealth.
Scorpio.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Scorpio causes the birth of evil, sick, and timid men.
Scorpio.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Scorpio produces one whose wife is maimed or has died a violent death.
Scorpio.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Scorpio produces a man imperfect in speech and having bad friends.
Scorpio.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Scorpio produces one who is himself a slave and is born of a man like a slave or one who does the commands of and associates with sinful people.

Sagittarius.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Sagittarius gives beauty, dignity, and honor of his father.
Sagittarius.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Sagittarius gives beauty, dignity, and honor of his mother.
Sagittarius.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Sagittarius gives abundant vehicles, horses, and gold.
Sagittarius.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Sagittarius causes the birth of one who is looked upon in a hostile manner by his elders.
Sagittarius.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Sagittarius gives a wife who is praised for her good qualities.
Sagittarius.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Sagittarius gives perfection in speech and friendship and ...
Sagittarius.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Sagittarius causes the birth of youthful men who have the good fortune of Cupid.

Capricorn.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Capricorn causes the loss of his father.
Capricorn.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Capricorn causes a wind-disease of his mother.
Capricorn.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Capricorn destroys the acquisition of good, peacefulness, and memory.
Capricorn.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Capricorn causes the birth of famous sons.
Capricorn.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Capricorn produces a man whose wife has trembling limbs and twitching eye-brows.
Capricorn.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Capricorn produces a man defective in speech whose friendship is bad.
Capricorn.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Capricorn produces a man who ages quickly and is surrounded by tanks, cows, and servants.

Aquarius.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Aquarius causes disease, sickness, and defects of his father.
Aquarius.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Aquarius causes disease, sickness, and defects of his mother.
Aquarius.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Aquarius gives memory and wealth.
Aquarius.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Aquarius gives servants, slaves, and sons.
Aquarius.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Aquarius produces a man who is the husband of a slave-girl or of an old woman.
Aquarius.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Aquarius produces one who is robbed of speech and has bad friends.
Aquarius.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Aquarius produces a man with good friends who looks like an old man or who is honored by slaves.

Pisces.Sun: The Sun in a dvadasamsa of Pisces causes joy, honor, and wealth of his father.
Pisces.Moon: The Moon in a dvadasamsa of Pisces causes joy, honor, and wealth of his mother.
Pisces.Jupiter: Jupiter in a dvadasamsa of Pisces makes many heaps of jewels.
Pisces.Mars: Mars in a dvadasamsa of Pisces gives sons who are hostile to his allies.
Pisces.Venus: Venus in a dvadasamsa of Pisces produces one whose wife is opposed by a great arhat.
Pisces.Mercury: Mercury in a dvadasamsa of Pisces produces a man corrupted in speech who has evil friends.
Pisces.Saturn: Saturn in a dvadasamsa of Pisces produces a youthful person who serves men of good qualities.
